instruction: Candid documentary full shot of an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and white walls. In the center, the bearded man in a dark shirt and blue shorts (R1) and the woman in a white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) are embracing face-to-face. The woman has her back to the camera, wrapping her arms around the man's neck, while the man faces forward, holding her close with his arms around her shoulders. The background shows white walls with radiators and mounted cameras. Bright overhead studio lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
